🔻 Officials from 100 countries to attend Ayatollah Khamenei’s funeral ceremony

📌 Tehran, IRNA — Representatives from 100 countries, including heads of state, parliamentary leaders, foreign ministers, and special government envoys, will attend the farewell funeral procession for Martyr Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei, the Foreign Ministry spokesperson announced.

“The tribute and farewell ceremony will begin at 8:00 AM on Friday, July 3, with the participation of dignitaries and public groups. High ranking officials from different countries and political figures will attend the ceremony in the afternoon same day,” Esmaeil Baqaei said on Thursday.
​
“The farewell and funeral ceremony for Martyr Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei is considered a historic and highly significant event, not only for the Iranian nation but also for the people of the region, Muslims, and all free nations worldwide,” the spokesperson further added
​
Also a farewell ceremony for Ayatollah Khamenei is scheduled to be held on Saturday and Sunday, July 4 and 5, at the Imam Khomeini Musalla in Tehran.
​
The funeral procession will take place in the capital on Monday, July 6. A procession will follow in the holy city of Qom on Tuesday, July 7, and a final procession will be held in the holy city of Mashhad on Thursday, July 9.
​
Martyr Ayatollah Khamenei will be laid to rest at the sacred shrine of Imam Reza (AS) in Mashhad.
​
Ayatollah Khamenei was martyred on Saturday, February 28, in a deliberate terrorist attack carried out by the US and Israeli regime enemies.

The boldest experiment in crypto

Michael Saylor, the founder of Strategy, the world's largest corporate holder of Bitcoin, has come up with something unique.

Instead of simply buying Bitcoin with the company's own money, he's building an entire financial machine that attracts outside capital and channels it into BTC purchases.

One of these instruments is STRC. Investors provide capital to the company and receive regular payouts of around 11.5% annually. The company then uses that capital to buy Bitcoin. But there's a catch.

⚙️ How it’s supposed to work

STRC — an instrument Saylor designed with the help of AI — is intended to keep its price hovering around $100.

If the price falls, the company raises the yield to attract more buyers. The price is supposed to recover. Think of it as an automatic stabilizer.

❓ Why this is interesting 

Right now, STRC is trading at roughly $83, despite its $100 target value. The yield has already been increased, but the market isn't responding the way the model was designed to.

This is the first real stress test of the entire structure. If the mechanism fails to stabilize the price, the company will either have to keep increasing payouts to investors or buy less Bitcoin.

Saylor is essentially testing one question: can financial instruments be built around a single asset indefinitely?

Euro Digital: Europe is preparing money that will work even without the internet

Euro digital has taken a new step forward in Brussels.

The idea is for any citizen to be able to pay with a digital version of the euro, issued by the European Central Bank (ECB), including without an internet connection.

Payments can be made with a phone, card, online, and offline - and rely less on Visa, Mastercard, and private banks.

### What is already raising questions:
- Limits will be set on how much digital euros can be stored.
- Many stores may be required to accept it.
- Banks fear that some of the money will be taken from their accounts.
- Millions of citizens are concerned about privacy of data.

The ECB promises that digital euro will not replace cash, and offline payments will have an increased level of confidentiality (similar to cash).

However, the discussion in Europe has long gone beyond just the technology.

This is a question of power: do we need public digital money or are we opening the door to too much control over how we pay?

📌 Smart Wallets: The Next Step in Crypto Convenience

Main Points
⏺ Smart wallets automate transactions and add recovery options without compromising security.
⏺ They use programmable logic to execute rules like auto-payments or limit orders.
⏺ This post explains why smart wallets are the next evolution in self-custody.

1️⃣ Automation — wallets can send recurring payments or rebalance portfolios automatically.
2️⃣ Recovery — no more lost seed phrases; users can restore access via social or multi-signature systems.
3️⃣ Security — built-in permissions reduce human error and scams.
4️⃣ Adoption — MetaMask Snaps and Argent are leading the innovation.
5️⃣ Future Outlook — expect smart wallets to replace traditional ones as default Web3 tools.

Smart wallets make crypto as easy as online banking — but with full control in your hands.
